description: Structured evidence for reconstructing the changing footprint of 600 Stockton Street over time.

periods.description: The site predates the Metropolitan Life headquarters. The Sanborn map is being used to establish the buildings and parcel conditions that existed before the 1909 construction.

periods.description: The Sanborn map documents the Metropolitan Life building during the early expansion period. The original Stockton-facing structure can be compared with the enlarged footprint shown in this period.
